Sampling density within five-minute buckets

1 observation per bucket ≈ every 5 minutes; 5 observations ≈ every minute. Missing recordings can reduce these counts.

Percentages use buckets with n > 0, pooled across participants; zero/missing counts and sleeprate are excluded. GPS coordinates have no individual counts.
